import subprocess
from pathlib import Path

repo = Path("/Users/steventran/jobpipe")
py = str(repo / ".venv" / "bin" / "python")
run = subprocess.run(
    [py, str(repo / "jobpipe.py"), "scout", "--profile", "config/jobpipe.search.yaml", "--limit", "100"],
    cwd=repo,
    capture_output=True,
    text=True,
    timeout=840,
)
print(run.stdout)
print(run.stderr)
raise SystemExit(run.returncode)
